arguments.value: Plain-English summary: The parties agree to file a joint Schedule 13G or 13D and any future amendments together with regulators, each reporting their ownership of the issuer’s securities. Each party is responsible for filing its own information accurately and on time, but is not responsible for verifying the other party’s information unless it knows or has reason to believe that information is inaccurate.
